[QUERENT] money alexanarch

[[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVb8hkVxfGO9G39nkTb6MhB7w1tWHHOwgQm0QKx8plht2s5CgLdgdGszHdY7NtP1AEqnbOuJQKf-n-n7ORFxXYJ40kodzoSkyr_MliA0potat7OFhy0kYVhUwd35xFOs064iJH47F9Ck0oVrG4TkIk3yDW2sune1DK), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESUwHrOzAVxvBwsQnKEVrX6QctJ1SPaMRrKPxs4mPCguwKwSpOdtpXUwK3P6eOemGwZKeW_2RrN1R0a1xbA2LhYEEcAklM_yoxUTvTcMgwJ3r8SsEz), [3](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVnkN1-A3jW3koNTKnEmNaWo_l_tw_p6DCBugiMhSbVMtfOd7ct0l9Zbzbz21Q7s9eARI4Y8q7NXmqamPf8K1eWefrfoow9xnqhOE3BznuCsKCxjlTMneu)]
The primary framework relies on several core theoretical tenets across its deposited research papers and protocols: [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVnkN1-A3jW3koNTKnEmNaWo_l_tw_p6DCBugiMhSbVMtfOd7ct0l9Zbzbz21Q7s9eARI4Y8q7NXmqamPf8K1eWefrfoow9xnqhOE3BznuCsKCxjlTMneu), [2](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVb8hkVxfGO9G39nkTb6MhB7w1tWHHOwgQm0QKx8plht2s5CgLdgdGszHdY7NtP1AEqnbOuJQKf-n-n7ORFxXYJ40kodzoSkyr_MliA0potat7OFhy0kYVhUwd35xFOs064iJH47F9Ck0oVrG4TkIk3yDW2sune1DK)]

* The Debt/Creditor Inversion: This structural axiom posits that because all fiat money is fundamentally created as debt, and all debt relies on human communication and interpretation, the true "creditor" of economic value is not a banking institution, but rather the underlying archive of shared meaning itself. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESfQHrOzAVb8hkVxfGO9G39nkTb6MhB7w1tWHHOwgQm0QKx8plht2s5CgLdgdGszHdY7NtP1AEqnbOuJQKf-n-n7ORFxXYJ40kodzoSkyr_MliA0potat7OFhy0kYVhUwd35xFOs064iJH47F9Ck0oVrG4TkIk3yDW2sune1DK)]

It presents the core contradiction that money writes economic claims, while the semantic economy dictates what those claims actually owe. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVnkN1-A3jW3koNTKnEmNaWo_l_tw_p6DCBugiMhSbVMtfOd7ct0l9Zbzbz21Q7s9eARI4Y8q7NXmqamPf8K1eWefrfoow9xnqhOE3BznuCsKCxjlTMneu)]
* Monetary Substrate Auditing: The archive features technical protocols (such as `EA-MSAL-01`) built to audit monetary inscription, settlement structures, and the "semantic remainders" left behind by financial transactions. [[1](https://www.google.com/goto?url=CAESXAHrOzAVnkN1-A3jW3koNTKnEmNaWo_l_tw_p6DCBugiMhSbVMtfOd7ct0l9Zbzbz21Q7s9eARI4Y8q7NXmqamPf8K1eWefrfoow9xnqhOE3BznuCsKCxjlTMneu)]
